name: Emberfall Cellar
description: The cellar of the old chapel. Somebody has cleared the rubble from a stair that winds down into the dark, and a lantern burns beside it.
random_events: The lantern gutters in a draught from below.
Far beneath you, something drags across stone.
hint: Talk to Maren, then take the stair down. Type 'map' whenever you lose your bearings.
